ruleDefinitions.name: Rundll32 Execution Without CommandLine Parameters
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious start of rundll32.exe without any parameters as found in CobaltStrike beacon activity

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\\rundll32$")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\.*")))
